fact: Failure to follow the Race Director's Event Notes.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code and noncompliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 17, document 3).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz), team representative and reviewed, video, and in-car video evidence. The driver failed to go around the bollard at Turn 3 having left the track at turn 2 during Q1. The driver explained that he left the track because he was out of control and was concerned with regaining control and as it was qualifying know that his lap time would be deleted. Considering that the lap was deleted, which is a penalty and no advantage was gained and no other driver impeded, the Stewards issue a warning.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
evidence presented. ### Tim Mayer Mathieu Remmerie ### Johnny Herbert Paul Ng
title: Infringement Car 55 Failure To Follow Race Directors Instructions
